eli5.text: The product was re-released under a new internal name (version 1.0.115) so that all the smaller improvements made since the last release get bundled together as one official update. If you updated to this version, you'd get a collection of mostly behind-the-scenes improvements: the assistant writes cleaner formatting when suggesting file edits, error messages while reading files are simpler, and LinkedIn analytics on the website now properly track which campaigns bring in visitors. This is the version you'd install if you wanted all the tweaks and fixes from late November 2024 in one consistent package.

ai.title: Enforce relative file paths in backend request handling
ai.summary: Moved path validation logic from `main-prompt.ts` to `request-files-prompt.ts` to enforce stricter file path requirements. The `requestRelevantFiles` function now filters out absolute paths and `..` segments, and explicitly strips leading slashes from returned paths. This ensures all generated file requests are relative to the project root, preventing silent failures in file operations. Updated `backend/knowledge.md` to document these path constraints and the need for change verification.

eli5.text: When the system asks for project files to read or edit, it now only accepts file locations written as plain relative addresses (like "src/utils/helpers.ts") instead of full computer paths (like "/Users/name/project/src/utils/helpers.ts") or shortcuts that jump outside the project folder (like "../other-folder/file.txt"). Any leading slash gets automatically removed so requests stay tied to the current project. This stops silent mistakes where the system might try to open the wrong file or fail without warning. It's now live and applies to every file request the system generates.
